text:
Type: floral flatwoven area rug with fringe
Use: anchoring a seating or dining area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, classic
Materials: flatwoven yarn, short fringe on both ends
Colors: off-white cream, dove grey, charcoal grey
Shape: rectangular, flat, allover branching flowers and leaves, double frame border with a dark charcoal outer band, fringed ends, light
Feel: soft, gentle, romantic, calm
Goes with: white or painted wood, linen, grey and cream textiles; farmhouse, cottage or traditional rooms

product.name: ALVINE
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
